title: Opening system monitor configuration window of an applet instance discards pending changes in any already-existing config windows
line: Opening another widget's settings while the open settings window has unapplied changes now asks whether to apply or discard them instead of silently losing them.
explanation: The desktop and each panel keep a single widget settings window. When the settings of a different widget were requested, DesktopView and PanelView hid and deleted the existing window directly, which skipped the window's own close handling, so unapplied changes were dropped without a prompt. The change closes the existing window through QWindow::close() first; if it has unsaved changes, its existing Apply/Discard/Cancel prompt appears and the new settings window is not opened, otherwise it is replaced as before.

commits.message:
shell: ask about unsaved changes before configuring another widget

Opening the settings of a widget while another widget's settings window
had unapplied changes silently replaced that window and lost the changes.
Close the open window first so it can ask to apply or discard them.

BUG: 430564

media.caption: Before: CPU widget settings with an unapplied title change, choosing Configure Memory Usage
Before: the window switches to Memory Usage with no prompt and the CPU title change is lost
After: same steps, unapplied title change, choosing Configure Memory Usage
After: the open window asks to apply or discard the changes first

review.text: Goes through QWindow::close() so ConfigView's existing unsaved-changes prompt runs instead of deleting the window behind its back; replacement only proceeds when close is accepted. Same small change in both DesktopView and PanelView; the screenshot shows the Apply/Discard/Cancel prompt.
